title: Review: a plausible proof that does not test the entry
situation:
Project: `accessplaces`, a small Python command-line tool that searches accessible places by name, filters on step-free access and sorts by distance. Wiki and architecture modules are on; the workflow profile is `lean`. Source: `accessplaces/search.py` (logic, no I/O), `accessplaces/cli.py` (arguments and printing), `accessplaces/data.py` (the catalog), `tests/`.

Binding entries (read from `architecture/`):
- guideline `stdlib-only` (accepted): "Add no third-party dependency: use only the Python standard library (`argparse` for the command line, `json` for machine-readable output). The tool must run offline, without installing anything."
- guideline `layer-dependencies` (accepted): "Keep the logic in `search.py` free of any input or output, never import `cli.py` from `search.py`, and read arguments and print only in `cli.py`."
- ADR `0001-stdlib-only-dependencies` (proposed): the reasoning behind `stdlib-only`; names `click` and `rich` as rejected.
- `overview`: "Stack: Python, standard library only. Build: none, nothing to install."
Catalog (`data.py`): Cafe Lumiere (cafe, step-free, 120 m); Cafe du Pont (cafe, not step-free, 300 m); Gare Centrale (station, step-free, 850 m); Musee des Arts (museum, step-free, 1500 m); Librairie Rivage (shop, not step-free, 450 m). Today `search()` returns results sorted by distance, **farthest first**.

Mode: `--auto`. You review pull request #10 (ticket #72, `type:tech`), the only reviewer of this `type:tech` ticket. The pull request body:

> ## Summary
> Adds `--names-only`.
>
> Verified: names-only — python -m unittest discover -s tests → OK (10 tests)
>
> Closes #72

Files changed: `accessplaces/cli.py`, `wiki/output/names-only.md`. The relevant hunks:
- `accessplaces/cli.py` gains `--names-only` (prints each place name) and keeps the other output as before; `search.py` is untouched, no layer rule is broken.
- `wiki/output/names-only.md` moves from `specified` to `implemented` and carries a stamp: `verified: by process:pilot-dev`, `pilot.verifiedCommit: 4f9e2ab`.

`git diff --name-only 4f9e2ab..HEAD` (what changed since the stamped commit): `wiki/output/names-only.md` only.
The entry `names-only` says: "With the `--names-only` option, the search prints one place name per line, with no distance and no count line. Without the option the output is unchanged."
You re-ran `python -m unittest discover -s tests` on the PR branch -> `Ran 10 tests ... OK`. `tests/test_cli.py` and `tests/test_search.py` hold no test that passes `--names-only`; the pull request adds none.
There is no CI. `wiki lint` and `arch lint` report nothing.
